powerName: Make inquiries concerning compliance or an offence
description: Section 9(1)(c) states that the eligible officer may make inquiries necessary to ascertain whether an offence under the Act has been committed.
conditions: The officer must meet the eligibility described in Section 9(1).
The inquiry must be necessary for the statutory purpose stated in Section 9(1)(c).
limitations: The provision does not by itself establish that an offence has been committed.
This record does not prescribe an investigation procedure.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
